Aditya Roy Kapur Confirms He's In A Relationship, Here's His New Girlfriend After Ananya Panday
Aditya Roy Kapur's latest film, Metro In Dino, is a take on modern relationship dynamics.
Aditya Roy Kapur’s dating life has always caught everyone’s attention. The Metro In Dino was previously dating Ananya Panday, but had been single since their breakup last year. However, during his film’s promotions, he confirmed that he is now in a relationship. Who is Aditya Roy Kapur dating? That’s a catch!
Aditya Roy Kapur said, “Right now, I’m in a relationship… with this thing called Metro In Dino." Aditya’s cheeky comment left the audience and his co-star Sara Ali Khan in splits. Have a look here:

The actor was previously dating Ananya Panday. Ananya and Aditya reportedly dated for nearly two years before calling it quits. Ananya Panday and Aditya Roy Kapur’s breakup rumours made headlines in April last year after the actress shared a cryptic note on her Instagram stories.
Later, a close friend of the two actors told the Bombay Times, “They broke up almost a month ago. They were going quite well, and the breakup came as a shock to all of us. They are cordial with each other. Ananya is trying to move on; of course, there’s hurt. She is spending time with her new furry friend. Aditya is also trying to deal with the situation maturely."
However, it should also be noted that Ananya and Aditya have not reacted to their breakup rumours. They also never explicitly spoke about their relationship. After their breakup, Ananya and Aditya continued to fulfil their brand commitments, and Aditya even featured in a beverage ad with Chunky Panday, leaving the internet divided.
Metro In Dino Review
As for Aditya’s new love, Metro In Dino, News18 Showsha gave the film 4/5 stars. Our review read, “Even at 2 hours 42 minutes, there’s hardly a moment where Metro In Dino loses pace. Anurag manages to hold your attention for close to three hours, and to be able to do that in a romantic drama is an achievement in itself."
“The comedy, the drama, the tension – Metro In Dino nails it all! The first half is terrific, extraordinary, making you laugh and think and shed a tear or two, all at once. The action drops a tad in the second half, but that hardly impacts the narrative. And what’s interesting and special is that the film is sprinkled with references from Life In A Metro," the review also mentioned.
